specs.title: ordinary game URL exposes architecture attribution without mutable QA hooks
capture cameras retain visible source landmarks and cull them when looking away
all fixed source buildings have damage templates and collision, with complete licensed near models
source damage opens collision, survives tile eviction and resets without debris or collider leaks
support loss drives partial and complete collapse while debris stays capped
destroyed harbor cranes restore their source instances and support collision on restart
menu, real input traversal, takeoff, braking, pause and resume
heavy punch transfers to jointed ragdoll, wall collision, then recovers
grab, throw, persistent fracture and restart body cleanup
flight collision crashes into physical ragdoll and returns control
mission transitions, missiles, boss phases, finisher and clean restart
hardware frame measurement and bounded repeated restart
pilot and armour are both playable: T runs the part-by-part transformation, flight needs the armour
free fall is gravity-driven, can be caught, and landings are graded by impact speed
shoulder launchers deploy, fire guided and unguided missiles and stow; palms aim before the hand weapons fire
soft lock reaches useful ranges, respects line of sight, spreads a salvo, and a hard lock survives camera movement
flight follows the view in three dimensions: climb, dive, banked turn, and a free view in the hover
combat: a buffered three-hit combination, hit windows tied to the fist, counter, dash and clean exits
weapons in flight and sound lifecycle: palm aims while hovering, the beam ends on what it hits, its tone starts once and stops
licensed street meshes retain metre-scale shape after integer quantization
ordinary authored buildings also collapse after critical foundation loss while active presentations stay bounded
damage evicts heavy meshes, retains state and restores holes when returning
pooled fire, smoke and source debris stay capped through repeated impacts
landmark signage disappears during full collapse and returns with a clean restart
all districts, precipitation, sky and material shaders render without errors
weather transition, solar lighting, effects cleanup and restart
repeated cross-city traversal and restarts keep GPU and physics resources bounded
rooftop landing and swept fast flight work with authored buildings
quality changes preserve layout and collision and debug UI is opt-in
bridge landing, ramp traversal and environment disposal preserve hero-owned physics
latest pilot walks and runs into authored city collision and stands on an industrial roof
real climb passes the old ceiling, powered recovery works, and the world edge returns safely
intact source buildings occlude targeting; sustained weapons open persistent holes
all ten weather presets, audio toggle and repeated world construction/disposal coexist with the current hero
flight passes under the authored bridge and a fast fall lands on an industrial crane platform
Phase 8 real L input heats and cuts source geometry, then cools without losing saved damage
Phase 8 real O/F inputs latch demolition, increase building damage and respect cooldown
Phase 8 progressive collapse during rain stays bounded and survives a city snapshot restore
Phase 8 demolition missiles retain the original direct enemy damage
Phase 9 stationary ground Y uses 3/3/2 real missile waves before the player chooses movement
Phase 9 stationary hover Y uses 3/3/2 real missile waves before the player chooses movement
all tall-building families have complete geometry available outside streamed tiles
complete skyscrapers remain in the distant skyline while orbiting and changing far planes
damage updates only owned triangle buffers and keeps surviving floor collision resident
street detail compiles on LOW and wet night without errors and has grounded lamps
source-attached missile fire stays on surviving geometry, collapse clears attachments, pools reset
